n.lib.submit.server-busy-saved.en: Hawkeye is busy right now — your signed report is saved on this phone and will send itself as soon as it can.
n.lib.submit.server-busy-saved.ha: Hawkeye yana cike da aiki yanzu — an ajiye rahotonka da aka sanya wa hannu a wannan wayar, kuma zai aika kansa da zarar ya yiwu.
n.lib.submit.server-busy-saved.ig: Hawkeye nọ n'ọrụ ugbu a — e chekwara akụkọ ị bịanyere aka na ya n'ekwentị a, ọ ga-ezipụ onwe ya ozugbo o kwere.
n.lib.submit.server-busy-saved.yo: Hawkeye ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ báyìí — a ti fi ìròyìn rẹ tí o fọwọ́sí pamọ́ sórí fóònù yìí, yóò sì fi ara rẹ̀ ránṣẹ́ ní kété tí ó bá ṣeé ṣe.
